# 14. Post-Release Tracking

**Goal:** learn from what shipped and feed it back into the backlog.
**Template:** `assets/post-release-review-template.md` → `reports/post-release-<version>.md`.

## Steps

1. **Metrics review:** compare actuals with the PRD success metrics (baseline, target, actual). Mark each Met / Missed / Too early. For "too early", set a dated follow-up check.
2. **Issue tracking:** list defects and incidents since release with severity and status. Make sure each has a tracker item.
3. **Feedback collection:** gather feedback from users, support, and stakeholders. Note the source.
4. **Future backlog updates:**
   - Turn issues and feedback into backlog items, ranked ([05-backlog.md](05-backlog.md)).
   - Re-prioritize deferred stories.
   - Update the PRD (success metrics, scope notes) and record decisions.
5. **Retrospective notes:** what went well, what to improve in this workflow.
6. Share the review with stakeholders.

## Done when

- [ ] Metrics compared with targets (follow-ups dated)
- [ ] All issues tracked
- [ ] Feedback captured and triaged
- [ ] Backlog updated and re-ranked

**Next:** back to [01-prd.md](01-prd.md) (new initiative) or [05-backlog.md](05-backlog.md) (next release)
